title: The draft status chip sits in the same place in every pillar's item header
body:
## Source

Measured on objectui main `d4bc81eab`, 2026-10-15, in a writable package. Data pillar: "Unpublished draft" is the chip right after the api-name chip, beside the title. Automations: the same, beside the title. Interfaces: "Unpublished draft" sits at the far right of the item header, next to the Design / Run toggle. Access: "This package's objects · saved as draft" sits beside the title. Four headers, two positions.

## Target

1. The status chip is the item header's second chip in every pillar: after the api-name or kind chip, before the meta slot.
2. The right slot holds actions only (Design / Run, the Enabled switch, Explain access, the saved-at meta).
3. `StudioItemHeader` takes the chip through `chips`, so the pillars stop placing it themselves.

## File surface

`packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (`ifHeaderEl` and the Access header), `StudioItemHeader.tsx`, tests beside.

## Acceptance

1. A test renders the four headers with a draft item and asserts the chip's position (the same parent, the same index) in all four.
2. Screenshots of the four headers at 1280 px, light and dark.
3. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell test` green.

## Constraints

- Coordinate with #12455 (Interfaces header) and #12456 (Access header): whichever lands first, the other rebases.
- Existing `data-testid`s stay.

<sub>Filed by the epic PM session `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` from the 2026-10-15 Studio test pass: objectui main `d4bc81eab`, HotCRM `63db83e2`, the vite console on :5180 against `objectstack serve --dev` on :4001, viewport 1482 × 1119, dark theme with a light-theme check.</sub>

## Evidence

Screenshots from the test pass, kept on the temporary branch `claude/studio-test-pass-evidence-20261015` of objectstack-ai/objectui (commit `72115588c`, never merged: the maintainer ruled that screenshots do not enter main, and asked for a temporary branch referenced from the card). The branch's `docs/design/studio-redesign/findings/2026-10-15/README.md` maps every file to its card. Pane captures, 800 × 604 of a 1482 × 1119 viewport, dark unless named light.
